title: Build a product strategy
summary: Strategy is how you plan to reach the vision: which problems to focus on, which to ignore and why. Good strategy is mostly about saying no.

beginner: Start from the vision and company goals.
List the biggest problems standing in the way.
Pick two or three to focus on.
Say what you will not do.
Share it and use it to prioritise.
intermediate: Analyse users, market, competitors and your organisation's strengths.
Identify the few insights that give you an edge.
Choose two or three focus areas and explicit non-goals.
Turn focus areas into objectives and roadmap themes.
experienced: Diagnose the core challenge before choosing actions.
Make hard trade-offs visible and get leadership to commit to them.
Sequence bets so early ones create advantage for later ones.
Review strategy regularly against results and change course when evidence demands.

toolExamples.google-docs: Write a short strategy narrative: diagnosis, focus areas, non-goals and how you will measure progress.
toolExamples.miro: Map the challenges and cluster them before choosing focus areas.
toolExamples.claude: Paste your strategy and ask it to find the weakest assumption.

definitionOfDone: Strategy linked to objectives and roadmap
pitfalls: A list of goals called a strategy
Strategy written once and never revisited
